description: This header file declares functions and includes necessary type headers for sensing operations related to the wld TH (perhaps 'Wireless LAN test helper') module, providing interfaces for getting vendor data, sending sensing commands, managing clients, and resetting statistics.

methods.name: sensingGetVendorData
methods.description: Returns vendor-specific sensing data given a radio pointer.

methods.name: wld_th_rad_sensing_cmd
methods.description: Sends a sensing command related to a radio.

methods.name: wld_th_rad_sensing_addClient
methods.description: Adds a client for sensing operations associated with a radio.

methods.name: wld_th_rad_sensing_delClient
methods.description: Deletes a client identified by MAC address from sensing management.

methods.name: wld_th_rad_sensing_csiStats
methods.description: Retrieves CSI (Channel State Information) statistics for a radio.

methods.name: wld_th_rad_sensing_resetStats
methods.description: Resets sensing-related statistics for a radio.
